name: Questarr
description: Questarr is an *Arr-inspired game manager. It helps you discover, track and automatically download the games you want, using IGDB metadata, Torznab/Newznab indexers and your download client.

notes.text: Create the admin account on first visit to the web UI.
Game discovery needs IGDB credentials (Twitch developer app). Enter them under Settings, or set IGDB_CLIENT_ID and IGDB_CLIENT_SECRET in /opt/questarr/.env.
Data lives in the SQLite database at /opt/questarr/data/sqlite.db.
